key.name: screen-time-enabled
key.description: Record how long each app is used, for Wellbeing and parental controls. The data stays on this computer.

key.name: break-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of continuous use before a break reminder

key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: List of desktop file IDs pinned to the dock.

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Position of the dock (bottom, left, right)

key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: When enabled, the dock hides automatically when not in use.

key.name: dock-enabled
key.description: When disabled, the dock is not shown at all.

key.name: dock-intellihide
key.description: Hide the dock when a window is maximized on the same monitor.

key.name: panel-layout-left
key.summary: Items in the left panel section

key.name: panel-layout-center
key.summary: Items in the center panel section

key.name: panel-layout-right
key.summary: Items in the right panel section

key.name: dock-layout-left
key.summary: Items in the left dock section

key.name: dock-layout-center
key.summary: Items in the center dock section

key.name: dock-layout-right
key.summary: Items in the right dock section

key.name: bar-layout-edit-mode
key.summary: Edit the panel and dock layout

key.name: panel-flat
key.description: When enabled, the top panel has a solid black background instead of being transparent.

key.name: panel-flat-opacity
key.description: Opacity (0-100) of the flat top panel background. Only applies when the flat panel is enabled.

key.name: dock-gap
key.description: Gap in pixels between the dock and the screen edge, and between windows and the dock.

key.name: dock-magnification
key.description: Magnify dock icons on hover, macOS-style.

key.name: dock-extended-mode
key.description: Show window titles next to icons in panel mode.

key.name: dock-window-previews
key.description: Show live window previews when hovering a dock icon that has more than one open window.

key.name: background-dynamic-uri
key.description: URI of the dynamic wallpaper manifest (.dynamic.json, a time-based XML slideshow or an imported HEIC). While set, the shell keeps background-picture-uri pointing at the frame for the current time or appearance. Empty for a still wallpaper.

key.name: dynamic-wallpaper-coordinates
key.description: Latitude and longitude ("45.46,9.19") used to follow the sun. Empty uses the coordinates of the time zone, without any network access.

key.name: background-attribution-title
key.summary: Attribution title for the current background
key.description: Title of the current wallpaper. Empty when it carries no attribution.

key.name: background-attribution-author
key.summary: Attribution author for the current background
key.description: Creator credit for the current wallpaper. Empty when it carries no attribution.

key.name: recent-wallpapers
key.summary: List of recently used wallpaper URIs

key.name: artist-pack-apt-sources
key.description: List of apt repository base URIs treated as sources of curated Artist Packs (ncz-wallpapers-* debs) by the Desktop settings' Artist Pack browser. Only packages whose apt candidate URI is under one of these bases are listed for browsing/installing. Empty means no source is trusted, so the browser shows nothing rather than silently trusting an unconfigured repository. Distributions set this via a packaged gschema override (see dev.sinty.desktop.gschema.override in the distro's post-install), not by patching this default -- the whole point is that the trusted source list is deployment configuration, not something baked into the browser's code.

key.name: custom-shortcuts
key.summary: Map of action names to custom accelerator strings

key.name: custom-keybindings
key.description: Each entry is (id, name, accelerator, command, app id, desktop action). An entry runs the command line, or the named action of the app's desktop file when app id and action are set. An empty accelerator leaves the shortcut unbound.

key.name: portal-global-shortcuts
key.summary: Global shortcuts granted to apps through the portal
key.description: Each entry is (app id, shortcut id, description, accelerator). The shell binds the accelerator and forwards presses to the desktop portal, which tells the app. An empty accelerator keeps the shortcut granted but unbound.

key.name: privacy-camera-enabled
key.description: When off, the desktop portal reports the camera as disabled and sandboxed apps cannot ask to use it.

key.name: privacy-microphone-enabled
key.description: When off, the desktop portal reports the microphone as disabled to sandboxed apps.

key.name: privacy-location-enabled
key.description: When off, the desktop portal refuses every location request.

key.name: hand-control-enabled
key.description: Control the desktop using camera-tracked hand gestures.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Appearance mode: 'dual' (dark shell, light apps), 'light' (light shell and apps), or 'dark' (dark shell and apps).

key.name: background-effect
key.description: Material applied behind translucent desktop surfaces: disabled, glass, or blur.

key.name: interface-density
key.description: Size of rows, groups and pages in settings and apps: compact, medium or large.

key.name: window-transparency
key.description: Percentage of app window background transparency while a background effect is active.

key.name: blur-strength
key.description: Strength of the compositor blur used by background materials.

key.name: dark-mode
key.description: Whether dark mode is enabled.

key.name: theme-adaptive
key.description: When enabled, the appearance follows a daily schedule: the chosen theme-mode during the day and dark at night.

key.name: theme-adaptive-from
key.description: Time of day (HH:MM) at which the adaptive theme switches to dark.

key.name: theme-adaptive-to
key.description: Time of day (HH:MM) at which the adaptive theme returns to the chosen day mode.

key.name: night-light-enabled
key.description: Whether the warm night-light color temperature is applied.

key.name: night-light-temperature
key.description: Color temperature in Kelvin applied while night light is active.

key.name: night-light-adaptive
key.description: When enabled, night light follows a daily schedule instead of a manual switch.

key.name: night-light-adaptive-from
key.description: Time of day (HH:MM) at which adaptive night light turns on.

key.name: night-light-adaptive-to
key.description: Time of day (HH:MM) at which adaptive night light turns off.

key.name: night-light-dark-theme
key.description: When enabled, the appearance switches to dark while the adaptive night light schedule is active.

key.name: night-light-schedule
key.description: Whether the adaptive night light uses the manual times or runs from sunset to sunrise.

key.name: night-light-sun-from
key.description: Local sunset time (HH:MM) computed by the shell for the sunset to sunrise schedule.

key.name: night-light-sun-to
key.description: Local sunrise time (HH:MM) computed by the shell for the sunset to sunrise schedule.

key.name: night-light-sun-source
key.description: Where the sunset and sunrise times come from: location, timezone or empty when unknown.

key.name: output-hdr
key.description: Displays with HDR turned on, keyed by the display identity (make, model and serial) or the connector name.

key.name: output-sdr-brightness
key.description: Brightness of standard content in nits while HDR is on, keyed like output-hdr.

key.name: output-color-profiles
key.description: ICC profile file assigned to each display when colord is not used, keyed like output-hdr.

key.name: developer-mode
key.description: Whether the Developer settings page is shown.

key.name: bootloader-unlock-allowed
key.description: Mirrors the bootloader unlock consent shown in Settings. This key is display state only and controls nothing: the authoritative consent flag is held by the privileged atom-recovery agent, which stores it where recovery and the bootloader can read it without a user session.

key.name: singularity-theme
key.description: Name of the user theme to apply to Singularity apps. Must have a singularity/style.css inside a standard theme directory. Empty string means the built-in default theme.

key.name: dynamic-workspaces
key.description: Whether to automatically create/destroy workspaces.

key.name: workspace-count
key.description: Number of workspaces when dynamic mode is disabled.

key.name: workspaces-per-monitor
key.description: When enabled, every display has its own workspaces and switches them independently of the other displays.

key.name: sound-output-device
key.description: ID of the selected sound output device.

key.name: keyboard-layout
key.description: Selected keyboard layout ID.

key.name: keyboard-repeat
key.description: Whether to enable keyboard repeat.

key.name: show-tour
key.description: Whether to open the desktop tour at the next login. It is turned off once the tour opens.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: The accent color used by the desktop (blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, slate, wallpaper, custom).

key.name: custom-accent-color
key.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) used when accent-color is set to 'custom'.

key.name: custom-accent-colors
key.description: User-created custom accent colors (#rrggbb), shown as swatches in the accent picker.

key.name: show-desktop-icons
key.description: Whether to show icons from the configured desktop folder.

key.name: show-wallpaper-attribution
key.description: Whether to show the wallpaper title and author on the desktop background.

key.name: show-battery-percentage
key.description: Whether to show the battery charge percentage next to the battery icon in the panel.

key.name: auto-gtk-theming
key.summary: Use the Singularity GTK theme for all apps
key.description: When enabled, GTK apps use the Singularity theme (built from the same tokens as the shell) with the dark/light preference synced, and the manual GTK theme overrides are locked.

key.name: settings-in-window
key.description: When enabled, the Settings button opens a dedicated Settings window instead of using the sidebar.

key.name: quick-settings-tile-order
key.description: Order of tiles in the quick settings editor.

key.name: quick-settings-active-tiles
key.description: Tiles shown in quick settings.

key.name: stage-manager
key.description: Keep windows in groups, show one group at a time and the others as thumbnails in a strip on the left.

key.name: quick-settings-compact
key.description: Show quick settings tiles as compact icon controls.

key.name: high-contrast
key.description: Whether high contrast mode is enabled.

key.name: large-text
key.description: Whether large text mode is enabled.

key.name: screen-reader-enabled
key.description: Whether the screen reader (orca) is enabled.

key.name: always-show-focus
key.description: Keep the keyboard focus ring visible after using the pointer.

key.name: accessibility-menu
key.description: Show the accessibility menu in the top bar even when no accessibility feature is on.

key.name: reduce-motion
key.description: Replace movement, scaling and bouncing with short fades across the desktop and Singularity apps.

key.name: motion-duration-scale
key.description: Multiplies every Singularity animation duration. Values above 1 slow animations down for debugging.

key.name: color-filter
key.description: Color filter applied to the whole screen.

key.name: gamemode-auto
key.description: Automatically activate Game Mode when a fullscreen game is detected

key.name: mangohud-auto
key.description: Inject MangoHud overlay when launching games

key.name: tiling-enabled
key.description: Whether tiling window management is enabled.

key.name: tiling-layout
key.description: Window arrangement used by automatic tiling.

key.name: tiling-column-width
key.description: Width of each scrolling tiling column as a percentage of the work area.

key.name: tiling-gap
key.description: Space between tiled windows.

key.name: snap-layouts
key.description: Show a layout picker when the pointer rests on the maximize button or a window is dragged to the top edge.

key.name: snap-assist
key.description: After snapping a window, offer the other open windows to fill the remaining zones.

key.name: window-border-width
key.description: Width of the accent-colored window border.

key.name: preview-features-enabled
key.description: Whether experimental features are visible.

key.name: enabled-plugins
key.description: List of enabled plugin module names.

key.name: disabled-plugins
key.description: Plugins shipped by apps that the user turned off. App plugins are enabled unless listed here.

key.name: search-provider-overrides
key.description: Search providers the user turned on or off, by provider id. Providers not listed follow their manifest default.

key.name: dock-pinned-suffixes
key.summary: Dock items with pinned (always-expanded) suffix widgets
key.description: App ids whose dock-item suffix area stays expanded without hover.

key.name: force-ssd
key.description: Forces Server Side Decorations (SSD) by disabling CSD in GTK and Qt apps.

key.name: legacy-titlebar
key.description: Show a classic static titlebar with inline buttons instead of the floating hover window controls. Ignored when force-ssd is enabled.

key.name: window-rounded-corners
key.description: Round the corners of non-maximized, non-tiled app windows.

key.name: app-launcher-mode
key.description: Mode of the app launcher (fullscreen, menu)

key.name: switcher-style
key.description: Layout style of the Alt+Tab switcher: 'list' (vertical, icon+title) or 'grid' (horizontal icons)

key.name: do-not-disturb
key.description: When enabled, notifications are suppressed.

key.name: active-window-title
key.description: Title of the currently focused window. Updated by the shell.

key.name: hotspot-ssid
key.description: SSID broadcast by the Wi-Fi hotspot. Empty means use the hostname.

key.name: hotspot-password
key.description: Pre-shared key for the Wi-Fi hotspot. Empty means generate one.

key.name: hotspot-wpa3
key.description: When enabled, the Wi-Fi hotspot uses WPA3 (SAE) instead of WPA2.

key.name: dynamic-internet-enabled
key.description: Keep available uplinks active and move new traffic to the healthiest connection.

key.name: window-states
key.description: Per-app window size and maximized state, keyed by application ID.

key.name: shell-monitor
key.summary: Connector name of the monitor where shell windows spawn (e.g. DP-1). Empty = auto.

key.name: dock-multi-monitor
key.description: When enabled, the dock appears on every connected monitor.

key.name: panel-multi-monitor
key.description: When enabled, the top panel appears on every connected monitor.

key.name: app-folders
key.description: JSON object mapping folder IDs to {name, apps:[]} structures.

key.name: app-grid-order
key.description: Ordered list of grid item keys for the overview: app IDs, folder:<id> entries, and widget:<instance_id> entries (Android-style mixed grid).

key.name: dock-resources
key.description: List of URIs pinned to the dock - files, folders, and web links dropped onto the dock à la macOS. Membership only; ordering lives in dock-order.

key.name: dock-order
key.description: Interleaved order of the dock's pinned section: entries are pin:<app-id> and res:<uri>. Lets apps and dropped resources be reordered relative to each other. Items not listed fall back to their own settings' order.

key.name: overview-widgets
key.description: Tuples (instance_id, provider_id, width, height, config_json) describing each placed widget. width/height are in grid cells (e.g. 2x1, 2x2). config_json is provider-specific JSON-encoded state.

key.name: clock-use-12h
key.description: When enabled, the clock shows AM/PM instead of 24-hour time.

key.name: extreme-mode-active
key.description: When enabled, reduces power consumption for AMOLED displays by enforcing dark theme and minimizing brightness.

key.name: extreme-mode-saved-dark-mode
key.summary: Saved dark mode preference before extreme mode

key.name: extreme-mode-saved-animations
key.summary: Saved animations preference before extreme mode

key.name: mouse-acceleration
key.description: When disabled, the mouse uses a flat acceleration profile.

key.name: natural-scrolling
key.description: Applies to two-finger scrolling. Edge scrolling has its own direction, see touchpad-edge-natural-scroll.

key.name: touchpad-two-finger-scroll
key.description: Scroll with two fingers anywhere on the touchpad.

key.name: touchpad-edge-scroll
key.description: Scroll with one finger along the right or bottom edge of the touchpad. Works together with two-finger scrolling.

key.name: touchpad-edge-natural-scroll
key.description: Reverse the edge scrolling direction, independently of two-finger scrolling.

key.name: touchpad-circular-scroll
key.description: Keep scrolling by moving in a circle after starting on an edge: vertically from the right edge, horizontally from the bottom edge.

key.name: touchpad-scroll-speed
key.description: Multiplier applied to touchpad scrolling. 1.0 is the default speed.

key.name: spell-check-enabled
key.description: Underline misspelled words in text fields and offer corrections in their context menu.

key.name: gestures-enabled
key.description: Switch workspaces and open the overview and launcher by swiping with several fingers.

key.name: gesture-fingers
key.description: How many fingers switch workspaces and open the overview: 3, 4 or both. Other finger counts reach applications.

key.name: gesture-direction
key.description: natural: content follows the fingers; inverted: the opposite; follow-scroll: inverted only when natural scrolling is off.

key.name: gesture-two-dimensional
key.description: Change direction during a swipe: switch workspace and then open the overview, or move between workspaces inside the overview, in one movement.

key.name: gesture-sensitivity
key.description: How far the fingers travel for one workspace or one overview step.

key.name: gesture-threshold
key.description: Distance travelled before a gesture picks its first direction.

key.name: media-exclusive-playback
key.summary: Play one media source at a time
key.description: Pause other media players when one starts playing.

key.name: mono-audio
key.description: Mix stereo sound down to mono and play it on every speaker.

key.name: spell-autocorrect
key.description: Replace a misspelled word with the best suggestion when Space is pressed. Backspace right after restores the original word.

key.name: spell-suggestions
key.description: Show corrections for the word being typed, under the word or above the screen keyboard.

key.name: shortcut-cheatsheet-hold
key.description: Holding the Super key on its own shows the desktop shortcuts and the shortcuts of the focused app.

key.name: shortcut-cheatsheet-delay
key.summary: Hold delay for the shortcuts overview
key.description: How long Super must be held, in milliseconds, before the shortcuts overview appears.

key.name: press-hold-accents
key.description: Holding a letter shows its accented variants instead of repeating it.

key.name: spell-check-languages
key.description: Dictionary language tags such as en_US or it_IT; empty follows the session language.

key.name: spell-check-all-apps
key.description: Suggest corrections for the word being typed in apps that do not check spelling themselves, through the desktop input method.

key.name: spell-skip-apps
key.summary: Apps skipped by desktop spell checking
key.description: App ids that check spelling on their own. Apps whose id starts with dev.sinty. are always skipped.

key.name: input-method-engines
key.description: Input method engines to switch between, as framework:engine such as fcitx5:pinyin or ibus:hangul.

key.name: input-method-framework
key.description: Which installed input method framework provides engines. auto offers every installed one.

key.name: input-method-show-indicator
key.summary: Show the input method in the panel
key.description: Show the current input method in the panel when input methods are added.

key.name: dictation-enabled
key.description: Allow dictation with its keyboard shortcut.

key.name: dictation-engine
key.description: Speech recognition engine used for dictation. Recognition always runs on this computer.

key.name: dictation-model
key.description: Name or path of the installed speech model; empty picks the first installed one.

key.name: dictation-language
key.description: Language code such as en or it, or auto to let the engine detect it.

key.name: dictation-auto-punctuation
key.description: Keep the punctuation added by the speech engine. Spoken commands such as comma or new line always work.

key.name: dictation-auto-stop
key.description: Stop dictation after a pause.

key.name: dictation-silence-seconds
key.description: Seconds of silence that stop dictation.

key.name: dictation-command
key.description: A program that reads 16 kHz 16-bit mono audio on standard input and prints JSON lines with partial or text members. %l is replaced by the language.

key.name: screen-keyboard-enabled
key.description: Show the on-screen keyboard docked at the bottom of the screen.

key.name: display-brightness-limits
key.description: Minimum and maximum brightness percentage for each display connector; the brightness level is mapped into this range.

key.name: mouse-scroll-speed
key.description: Multiplier applied to mouse wheel scrolling. 1.0 is the default speed.

key.name: allow-tearing
key.description: Let fullscreen windows that request it present without waiting for vblank, lowering input lag.

key.name: xwayland-native-scaling
key.description: Let X11 apps render at the display resolution instead of being upscaled. Apps that ignore Xft.dpi appear smaller.

key.name: icon-theme
key.description: Icon theme used by the shell and all applications.

key.name: cursor-theme
key.description: Mouse cursor theme used by the shell and all applications.

key.name: remember-recent-files
key.description: When disabled, apps and the dock do not keep or show a history of recently used files.

key.name: global-menu-enabled
key.description: When enabled, application menus appear in the top panel. When disabled, applications show their own in-window menu bar instead (takes effect on next login).

key.name: rendering-mode
key.description: auto, hardware or software. Software is a safe fallback for GPUs whose driver crashes the hardware renderer.

key.name: lid-close-action
key.description: What happens when the laptop lid is closed and no external display is connected: suspend, lock or nothing.

key.name: lid-close-docked-action
key.summary: When the lid is closed with an external display
key.description: keep-working turns off the built-in screen and keeps using the external displays; suspend puts the computer to sleep anyway.

key.name: idle-dim-screen
key.summary: Dim the screen before it turns off
key.description: Dim the screens shortly before they turn off for inactivity.

key.name: screen-blank-ac
key.summary: Turn the screen off when plugged in
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the screens turn off while on AC power. 0 means never.

key.name: screen-blank-battery
key.summary: Turn the screen off on battery
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the screens turn off while on battery. 0 means never.

key.name: suspend-idle-ac
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the computer suspends while on AC power. 0 means never.

key.name: suspend-idle-battery
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the computer suspends while on battery. 0 means never.

key.name: power-button-action
key.summary: When the power button is pressed
key.description: ask shows the power off confirmation; suspend, power-off and lock act at once; nothing ignores the button.

key.name: updates-automatic-check
key.description: Look for operating system updates in the background at the chosen frequency.

key.name: updates-check-frequency
key.summary: How often to check for updates
key.description: daily or weekly.

key.name: updates-automatic-download
key.description: Download operating system updates in the background when the connection is not metered. They are still installed only when the computer restarts.

key.name: updates-last-check
key.description: Unix time of the last successful check for operating system updates.

key.name: updates-notified
key.description: Internal marker so the same update is announced only once.

key.name: text-recognition-languages
key.description: Languages used to recognize text in images, as engine language codes such as eng or ita. Empty follows the system language.

key.name: tablet-output
key.description: Connector name of the screen the graphics tablet is mapped to. Empty maps it to all screens.

key.name: tablet-keep-aspect
key.description: Shrink the active tablet area so that it has the same proportions as the mapped screen.

key.name: tablet-left-handed
key.description: Turn the tablet around by 180 degrees so that its buttons are on the right.

key.name: tablet-area-custom
key.summary: Use a part of the tablet
key.description: Use only the area in tablet-area instead of the whole tablet surface.

key.name: tablet-area
key.description: Left, top, width and height of the active tablet area in millimetres, as seen when the tablet is held normally.

key.name: tablet-pressure-curve
key.description: Control points x1, y1, x2, y2 of the cubic Bezier curve from the pen pressure to the pressure sent to apps, each from 0 to 1.

key.name: tablet-mouse-mode
key.description: Move the pointer relative to where it is instead of jumping to the point under the pen.

key.name: tablet-stylus-buttons
key.description: Action for each pen button (Stylus, Stylus2, Stylus3): left, right, middle, back or none. Missing buttons keep their default.

key.name: tablet-pad-buttons
key.description: Action for each tablet button (Pad, Pad2 to Pad9): a mouse button, none, action:NAME for a shell action or key:SHORTCUT for a keyboard shortcut. Missing buttons are sent to the app.
